DashboardWebhooks.title: Webhooks
DashboardWebhooks.description: Managed endpoints your workflow rules deliver signed events to.
DashboardWebhooks.noAccessDescription: Your role does not include webhook access. Ask an organization admin for the webhooks permission.
DashboardWebhooks.emptyDescription: Register an endpoint to receive signed workflow events, then reference it from a send webhook rule.
DashboardWebhooks.loadError: Webhook endpoints could not be loaded.
DashboardWebhooks.createDescription: SDP generates the signing secret. The URL cannot be changed later.
DashboardWebhooks.fieldUrlHelp: Must be https and reachable from the public internet.
DashboardWebhooks.secretShownOnce: Copy the signing secret now. It is shown only this once and cannot be retrieved later.
DashboardWebhooks.secretGraceNote: The previous secret keeps signing deliveries until {expiresAt}.
DashboardWebhooks.editDescription: The URL is fixed for the life of the endpoint. Create a new endpoint to change it.
DashboardWebhooks.rotateConfirmDescription: A new secret is generated immediately. The current secret keeps signing deliveries for {hours} hours so your receiver can switch over.
DashboardWebhooks.disableConfirmDescription: Workflow rules that reference it will fail until it is enabled again.
DashboardWebhooks.deleteConfirmDescription: The endpoint stops receiving deliveries permanently. Its delivery history is kept. Rules that reference it will fail.
DashboardWebhooks.toastDeletedReferencing: Endpoint deleted. {count} enabled workflow rule(s) still reference it.
DashboardWebhooks.errorCreate: The endpoint could not be created.
DashboardWebhooks.errorUpdate: The endpoint could not be updated.
DashboardWebhooks.errorRotate: The secret could not be rotated.
DashboardWebhooks.errorDelete: The endpoint could not be deleted.
DashboardWebhooks.errorRedeliver: The delivery could not be re-sent.
DashboardWebhooks.notFoundDescription: This webhook endpoint does not exist or was deleted.
DashboardWebhooks.deliveriesDescription: Every delivery attempt to this endpoint, newest first.
DashboardWebhooks.deliveriesEmpty: No deliveries yet. Attempts appear here when a workflow rule fires.
DashboardWebhooks.deliveryResponseTruncated: Response truncated to the first 4,096 characters.
DashboardWebhooks.deliveryRequestTruncated: Request body truncated in the log; redelivery is unavailable for this attempt.
